snippet.title: Welcome Back to Aeris — Demo Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4941720

Play the Free Demo:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/5310170

Welcome back to Aeris! A point-and-click psychological horror about reviving a Frutiger Aero minigame console shutting down in 7 days. Restore its dead channels with your guide Mora — and follow the strange traces appearing beyond the screen.

Music by Onure

#WelcomeBackToAeris #IndieHorror #FrutigerAero
